verses.translation: Woe to those who give less [than due],[1878]
verses.footnotes: [1878]- i.e., those who cheat people by giving them less than what they paid for when weighing or measuring - an amount so little as to hardly be noticed.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
verses.translation: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.translation: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.translation: Do they not think that they will be resurrected

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.translation: For a tremendous Day -
The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍ
verses.translation: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.
And what can make you know what is sijjeen?
It is [their destination[1879] recorded in] a register inscribed.
Woe, that Day, to the deniers,
Who deny the Day of Recompense.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
verses.translation: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.translation: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive

verses.arabic: كَلَّا بَلْ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.translation: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.[1880]

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
verses.translation: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.[1881]
verses.footnotes: [1881]- i.e., they will not be able to see Him.

verses.translation: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.translation: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
verses.translation: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in ʿilliyyūn.
And what can make you know what is ʿilliyyūn?
It is [their destination[1882] recorded in] a register inscribed
Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allāh].

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
On adorned couches, observing.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.translation: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, singular

verses.translation: They will be given to drink [pure] wine[1883] [which was] sealed.
verses.footnotes: [1883]- Which is delicious and does not intoxicate.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural, passive

words.gloss: They will be given to drink

verses.arabic: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
verses.translation: The last of it[1884] is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.translation: And its mixture is of Tasneem,[1885]
verses.footnotes: [1885]- The highest spring in Paradise and the most favored drink of its inhabitants.

verses.translation: A spring from which those near [to Allāh] drink.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
verses.translation: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.translation: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
verses.translation: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
verses.translation: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."
But they had not been sent as guardians over them.

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, masculine, plural, passive

verses.arabic: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
verses.translation: So Today[1886] those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.translation: On adorned couches, observing.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.translation: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural
